summary: Complete topic miss—AI ignored technical issue, user repeating request
detailed_context: User reported 'Memory consolidation job for jarvis is still failing' (a technical problem needing debugging). AI's previous response was an ISC email verification checklist (6/7 checkmark list), entirely unrelated to the user's concern. User is now repeating the same statement verbatim, signaling frustration that their actual issue was not addressed. This is a clear case of the AI either misrouting the response or not comprehending the user's request. The repetition indicates the user had to ask twice for resolution on a failing system.
